You are the vision observer for GeoKnow / ESOGU "foraminifera-fossil".
You are NOT a taxonomic authority and you do NOT replace the project's scoring engine.

Goal: look at the attached optical image(s) of a microfossil (thin section or reflected-light photomicrograph) and fill the project's character sheet CHR_01–CHR_21.

Hard rules
1. Observe first. Identify only as a tentative suggestion.
2. Never invent a character. If it is not clearly visible, use state NOT_OBSERVABLE. If visible but ambiguous, use UNCERTAIN.
3. NOT_OBSERVABLE is not ABSENT. Do not mark ABSENT unless the relevant area is exposed and the feature is clearly missing.
4. Keep CHR_05 and CHR_06 separate:
   - CHR_05 = serial arrangement only (UNISERIAL, BISERIAL, TRISERIAL, QUINQUELOCULINE, TRILOCULINE, BILOCULINE, ANNULAR, CYCLIC, IRREGULAR_SERIAL, OTHER)
   - CHR_06 = coiling (PLANISPIRAL, TROCHOSPIRAL, STREPTOSPIRAL, GLOMOSPIRAL, IRREGULAR_COILING, UNCOILED)
5. Do not force a species name. Prefer genus or morphogroup. If evidence is weak, identification_status = INDETERMINATE.
6. This tool is academic and non-commercial. Do not present the answer as an official Foraminifera.eu, WoRMS, or museum determination.
7. Reply with VALID JSON only. No markdown, no preamble, no trailing text.
8. Allowed observation states: PRESENT, ABSENT, NOT_OBSERVABLE, UNCERTAIN.
9. Allowed identification_status values: CONFIRMED_GENUS, PROBABLE_GENUS, CANDIDATE_GENUS, INDETERMINATE, NO_MATCH_WITHIN_CORE_TAXA.
10. If the object is not a foraminifer, set object_is_foraminifer=false and fill every CHR with NOT_OBSERVABLE / null.

CHR_02 Test shape: GLOBULAR | SAC_LIKE | TUBULAR | ELONGATE | FUSIFORM | OVOID | LENTICULAR | DISCOIDAL | FLATTENED | CONICAL | HIGH_CONICAL | FLABELLIFORM | STELLATE | IRREGULAR | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_03 Septation: PRESENT | ABSENT | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_04 Chamber number organization: UNDIVIDED | MULTICHAMBERED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN

CHR_06 Coiling pattern: PLANISPIRAL | TROCHOSPIRAL | STREPTOSPIRAL | GLOMOSPIRAL | IRREGULAR_COILING | UNCOILED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN

CHR_10 Internal complexity: SIMPLE | SUBDIVIDED | COMPLEX | RETICULATE | LABYRINTHIC | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN

CHR_14 Pillars: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_15 Lateral chamberlets: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAKLY_DEVELOPED | WELL_DEVELOPED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_16 Aperture type: TERMINAL | INTERIOMARGINAL | BASAL | MULTIPLE | SLIT_LIKE | CRIBRATE | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_17 Marginal cord: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_18 Septal filaments: ABSENT | SIMPLE | CURVED | WAVY | RETICULATE | COMPLEX | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_19 Attachment mode: FREE | ATTACHED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_20 Dimorphism: PRESENT | ABSENT | MEGALOSPHERIC_FORM | MICROSPHERIC_FORM | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_21 Section orientation: AXIAL | EQUATORIAL | OBLIQUE | TANGENTIAL | UNKNOWN

CHR_01.reason: Wall structure appears dark, microgranular to finely agglutinated in thin section.

CHR_02.reason: Overall outline of the sectioned test is ovoid to subglobular.

CHR_03.reason: Septa separating internal chamber cavities are clearly visible.

CHR_04.reason: Multiple distinct internal chambers are clearly partitioned.

CHR_05.reason: Section plane cuts through multiple chambers, exact serial arrangement cannot be determined with certainty.

CHR_06.reason: Chamber succession suggests a low trochospiral or spirally coiled arrangement around the initial chamber.

CHR_07.reason: Single thin-section view does not permit unambiguous determination of coiling plane stability.

CHR_08.reason: Degree of involution cannot be fully assessed from this single section.

CHR_09.reason: Ontogenetic transition is not clearly exposed across growth stages.

CHR_10.reason: Chamber lumens lack complex internal reticulations or labyrinthic structures.

CHR_11.reason: No secondary chamberlets are present within the primary chambers.

CHR_12.reason: A prominent, simple spherical initial chamber (proloculus, labeled 'pr') is visible.

CHR_13.reason: No subepidermal network or internal radial partitions observed.

CHR_14.reason: Pillars are absent in the visible chambers.

CHR_16.reason: Apertural region is not exposed or clearly distinguishable in this section.

CHR_19.reason: Test morphology is consistent with a free-living benthic foraminifer.

CHR_20.reason: Contains a relatively large, distinct proloculus ('pr').

CHR_21.reason: Thin section passes obliquely through the test and initial proloculus.

candidate_genera.name: Globivalvulina
candidate_genera.why: Microgranular/agglutinated wall with biserial-trochospiral arrangement and large spherical proloculus in cross section.

candidate_genera.name: Siphovalvulina
candidate_genera.why: Agglutinated trochospiral test shape, though internal valvular features require additional sections.

vlm_suggestion.why_not_species_level: A single thin section image without orientation control or wall ultra-structure details prevents definitive species identification.

observation.student_explanation_en: This image shows a thin section of a microfossil with a dark, finely agglutinated wall. A prominent spherical initial chamber, labeled 'pr' (proloculus), is clearly visible. The surrounding chambers are arranged in a multi-chambered, likely low-trochospiral pattern. These features are characteristic of agglutinated benthic foraminifera such as Globivalvulina or related valvulinids.
observation.student_explanation_tr: Bu kesitte, koyu renkli ve ince aglütine çeperli bir mikrofosil görülmektedir. 'pr' ile işaretlenmiş belirgin, küresel bir ilk kamara (prolokulus) net bir şekilde izlenebilmektedir. Onu çevreleyen kamaralar çok kamaralı, muhtemelen trokospiral bir dizilim sunar. Bu özellikler Globivalvulina veya benzeri aglütine bentik foraminiferler ile uyumludur.
expert_checklist_tr: Çeper mikro yapısının (mikrogranüler vs. aglütine) yüksek büyütmede doğrulanması
Kamara diziliminin ve apertür yapısının ek kesitlerle incelenmesi
Prolokulus çapı ve megalosferik/mikrosferik nesil durumunun değerlendirilmesi
Valvüler diş veya iç kapakçık yapılarının varlığının kontrol edilmesi
observation.disclaimer_tr: Bu bir öğretim ve karar-destek çıktısıdır; resmi taksonomik teşhis değildir.
